name: reactra
description: Author/validate/plan and (TODO: run) Reactra enzyme-reaction simulations on Aurora from one YAML + a MECH file via scripts/reactra_cli.sh; one row per experiment. stage='plan' is the cheap verified path (validate + plan, <25 s, no GPU); stage='run' is the full NNP/MM + OPES pipeline (~1h, UNVERIFIED on Aurora).
_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md s5). A thin 'skills' MCP tool reactra.plan(inputs, defaults) (or reactra.run) validates each row against row_schema, write_files-stages inputs.jsonl + the runner, and calls the loam-hpc run_batch(script_path=runner, inputs_path=jsonl, gpus=1, timeout_each). The runner resolves reactra_cli.sh + $REACTRA_MECH_OVERLAY worker-side from site.<system>.json and invokes the CLI via bash -lc. timeout_each 60s fits the plan path (verified <25 s); for stage='run' set timeout_each to the full allocation (e.g. >=7200 s -- the CM reference ran ~54 min) -- NOT validated here (# TODO(verify)). REACTRA_MECH_OVERLAY has NO shared copy: build the one-time mech-format overlay per campaign (SKILL 'One-time setup'). reactra CLI exit 4 is a terminal scientific outcome, not a transient failure; do not auto-resubmit it. Keep run.yaml's native_device_slots within the row's one-tile reservation.
